dimensions.evidenceA: People lay hold of and retain wisdom.
dimensions.label: Response

evidence.observation: Wisdom is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her.
Solomon says, “He is a tree of life to all those who do His will.”

record.tension: Fourth Maccabees attributes a tree-of-life saying to Solomon whose subject and response differ from the WEBU wording in Proverbs 3:18.
record.title: Which tree-of-life saying is attributed to Solomon?
